## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan supplement gathering material Dázhēn had omitted from, or come across after completing, the *Zhèngyuán lüèjí* ([KR6q0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0032)).

**Abstract**

Additional Chán figures and dialogues in the same anthology format as the parent work. Preserves its conservative editorial orientation.
